snippet.title: FROGGONIT Release Date announcement!
snippet.description:
Froggonit is coming to Steam on March 6th, 2026!

Took me more than 3 years 😮 but now it's finally ready!
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2276040/FROGGONIT/

FROGGONIT was trying to be the best explorer but accidentally covered the island with darkness!

Hop into this comedy adventure game full of secrets and help your animal friends restore the light!
